finding: The existing fixed-flux top-boundary provider ABI is already part of qualified F-SI28 source. Replacing that ABI globally would create avoidable regression surface. The dynamic F-SI29 capability needs richer trial output, but fixed-flux users do not.

refinement.preserve: Keep top_boundary_provider_t and fixed_flux_top_boundary_provider_t on their exact legacy explicit-flux evaluate signature.
refinement.add: Add a sibling dynamic_top_boundary_provider_t interface carrying candidate ponding plus an explicit rich result DTO with flux/head regime, surface-face conductivity and trial-local surface mass terms.
refinement.context: hydraulic_evaluation_context_t gains an optional dynamic_top_boundary pointer; existing top_boundary pointer remains unchanged.
refinement.routing: FSI_TOP_MODE_EXPLICIT_FLUX selects only the old fixed/simple provider path. FSI_TOP_MODE_DYNAMIC_PROVIDER selects only the new dynamic provider path. No implicit substitution is allowed.
refinement.headcalc: HeadCalc consumes only the generic dynamic provider contract and remains unaware of F-SI29-specific types or equations.

contract_reconciliation: This refines the F-SI30 contract toward a narrower and more backward-compatible realization while preserving every frozen semantic gate. It does not relax physics, tolerances, mass conservation, determinism or qualification scope.
architecture_reason: preserve qualified F-SI28 fixed-flux source where possible
avoid forcing richer trial-state DTOs onto providers that do not need them
